content: N'ige wheru ewhe, Chiokike kwunnu ele nda aị ọknani ọka agịda ige hite n'ọnu ele ọwhnurninya n'apna zị ichne ichne.
Kọvu kịtna, n'ọbochi ipne-aznụ ka, o kwunnu aị ọka hite n'ọnu Nnwọ a Jizọsi, bụ nye ọ họhiaru ma ọ bụru nye jeeri kpakara mkpe, nye o hiri n'aka a kpụ ọwa.

O nwernu igwugwu Nda a. Nnwọ wam bụ nhne Nda a bụ. O ji ikwu-ọnu a ke nwernu iknernema jigidne kpakara nhne. O jiri aka a snụsnama mmehie ọwa. Nga o mekworu ka, ọ dazịri ẹli n'akarikwnunga Chiokike n'oligwe, nye kakwo kpakara nhne n'olu.
Nnwọ wam kakwo ele enine izi lele kpa rẹwhna a “Nnwọ,” ke Chiokike nyernu a kakwo rẹwhna be.
Kwnornu nụ ọ zá enine izi ọbula ke Chiokike kannụ,

content.text: “Ji bụ Nnwọ m.
M ghọlam Nda ị tna.”

content: Mọbu, ọ zị́ masị enine izi ke Chiokike kannụ,

content.text: “M jọoburunu ị Nda,
ị jọoburu Nnwọ m.”

content: Nga Chiokike neeziya Nnwọ a nụ rime ọwa, ọ kaa,

content.text: “Kpakara ele enine izi Chiokike kpọnu a risi ẹli.”

content: Ka bụ nhne Chiokike kwuru gbasịri ele enine izi,

content.text: “Chiokike mernu ele enine izi a lele ruwhere,
ele izi a lele bẹkwnu neerne erne.”

content: Kọvu nhne gbasịri Nnwọ wam, Chiokike karụ,

content.text: “Chiokike, ngadna eze i jaazị tim tọm,
Mkpara ẹli-eze i bụ ikpe zị snam.
Ị whnụrnu nhne ọma n'anya, sno nhne ọjo irno,
kam kpayarụ, Chiokike, bụ Chiokike i teru i mọno ovu ọso n'ọnu,
bịta ị nụ hne kakwo kpakara ele ibne i.”
“Jị Jihova, ị tụru ntụ-ẹli ọwa hite nụ mbọm.
I ji aka ị lawụru kpụ oligwe.
Kpakara be joowhu, kọvu ị jaazị ọkwnukokwnu.
Be jaaka bụka lele iwo.
Ị jaapịakota be lele iwo olu,
be jaagbanwo be lele ikpe,
kọvu ị zị kpa ị zị nụ mbọm,
ọnu ọgwnugwnu awha ị jéebi ebi.”

content: Ọ zá enine izi ọbula ke Chiokike kannụ,

content.text: “Dazịri ẹli n'akarikwnunga m
tem dụ nga me jaabịta ele irno i
lele nhne ị jọotukwasi ọchi ị lawụru.”

content: Ele enine izi, kpakara be bụ́o ele o ziyaru o yinu ele jeekehịa ọznohia aka sa?
